title: Start Cinematic Scene
description: Stage the arrival scene. Choose defaults, then tune boats, ocean, sky, island, flying Pokemon, and camera. Save to apply changes automatically while the cinematic is open.

groups.label: Camera shots
groups.description: Keys 1 through 8 recall a shot. Key 9 prints the current camera. Flying Pokemon positions are shared between shots.

groups.label: Playback music
groups.description: Save a song selection, then press P in the game to play it from the beginning. Uses Music Volume.

groups.label: Boat ambience
groups.description: Both sounds loop together. Each volume is multiplied by the game SFX volume.

groups.label: Music rise and boat distance
groups.description: Music rises as Haru turns. Water and motor soften without restarting, then fade further as the camera leaves the boat.

groups.label: Ocean and sky
groups.description: Each environment has separate sky and ocean size, position, and rotation.

groups.label: Flying Pokemon
groups.description: Empty shot keys show an actor everywhere. Listed keys limit it to those shots and restart its flight whenever the shot begins.

groups.label: Wailord breach experiment
groups.description: Press the trigger key to replay from the beginning. The boat and ocean clocks keep running. Positions are relative to scene center.

audio.music.startShotKey.label: Boat music start shot
audio.music.startShotKey.description: Zero starts in any shot; 3 waits for Haru's island view.

experiments.wailordBreach.driftVelocity.label: Continuous backward drift
experiments.wailordBreach.driftVelocity.description: Added throughout the jump and to the splash. Positive Z drifts toward the stern in this scene.

experiments.wailordBreach.waterHeight.label: Water surface height
experiments.wailordBreach.waterHeight.description: Whale fragments below this level are hidden. Match the ocean surface.

experiments.wailordBreach.riseHeight.label: Vertical rise height
experiments.wailordBreach.riseHeight.description: Keep the raised center underwater so the lower body remains submerged.

experiments.wailordBreach.emergenceYawDe.label: Breach heading spin
experiments.wailordBreach.emergenceYawDe.description: Starting heading offset. Rotation passes through zero at the apex, then gradually slows while falling. Zero disables heading spin.

experiments.wailordBreach.rotationDampin.label: Spin slowdown
experiments.wailordBreach.rotationDampin.description: Higher values slow heading rotation more quickly after the apex. Zero preserves constant speed. Units are per second.

experiments.wailordBreach.sideFallAxis.label: World axis for sideways fall
experiments.wailordBreach.sideFallAxis.description: Positive X with 90 degrees falls toward screen right in shot 2. Heading spin continues independently and gradually slows.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallPivotDepth.label: Lower-body fall pivot
experiments.wailordBreach.fallPivotDepth.description: Used only by lower-body mode. World units below the body center at the apex; keep this point submerged.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallPivotMode.label: Fall contact model
experiments.wailordBreach.fallPivotMode.description: Surface contact slides up the body as it sinks and reduces sideways travel. Lower body restores the previous fixed-depth hinge.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallAccelerati.label: Gentle tip acceleration
experiments.wailordBreach.fallAccelerati.description: Higher values start tipping more gently and build speed later. Two is the original curve; three is the softer preset. Impact speed joins water braking smoothly.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallSinkAccele.label: Gentle sinking while tipping
experiments.wailordBreach.fallSinkAccele.description: Downward acceleration in world units per second squared, starting at zero speed at the apex. Zero keeps the pivot stationary until impact.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallTipDelaySe.label: Sink before sideways tip
experiments.wailordBreach.fallTipDelaySe.description: Seconds of gentle sinking before the sideways rotation starts. Heading spin continues. Delay is bounded to leave time before splash contact.

experiments.wailordBreach.riseEndProgres.label: Apex transition begins
experiments.wailordBreach.riseEndProgres.description: The apex is midway between the two transition markers. Vertical speed reaches zero for one instant, never for a fixed pause.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallStartProgr.label: Apex transition ends
experiments.wailordBreach.fallStartProgr.description: Together with the first marker, sets apex timing and the rise/fall acceleration durations.

experiments.wailordBreach.fallEndProgres.label: Sideways settling ends
experiments.wailordBreach.fallEndProgres.description: The sideways fall smoothly settles at the target angle here. Heading spin slows separately.

experiments.wailordBreach.splash.bodyLen.label: Impact footprint length
experiments.wailordBreach.splash.bodyLen.description: World units along the whale body. Spray origins follow its orientation at contact.

experiments.wailordBreach.splash.impactS.label: Distributed water contacts
experiments.wailordBreach.splash.impactS.description: Two rows cover the landing area. The total droplet budget is shared across contacts.

experiments.wailordBreach.splash.impactS.label: Tail-to-head impact timing
experiments.wailordBreach.splash.impactS.description: Time between the first and last water contact. Zero makes all contacts simultaneous.

sceneCenter.label: Shared scene center
sceneCenter.description: All positions are offsets from this point. Matching boat and Pokemon XYZ positions overlap. Y controls height.

fog.end.label: Fog reaches full strength at distance

island.position.label: Island position
island.position.description: Negative Z places the island ahead of option C at its current rotation.

camera.farClip.label: Maximum visible distance
camera.farClip.description: Increase this if an enlarged sky is clipped.

shots.*.cityAudio.contactFrames.label: Foot contact sprite frames
shots.*.cityAudio.contactFrames.description: Play once on entry to these walk or run sprite frames.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.dialogueResolutionS.label: Welcome dialogue resolution scale
shots.*.welcomeIntro.dialogueResolutionS.description: 1 uses 400 by 250. 3 uses 1200 by 750. The game resolution does not change.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.dialoguePages.label: Welcome dialogue after greeting
shots.*.welcomeIntro.dialoguePages.description: Each entry is one page of up to two lines. Use {name} for the signature. Pages auto-play when enabled; click or accept skips ahead.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.musicLeadSeconds.label: Black hold before boat
shots.*.welcomeIntro.musicLeadSeconds.description: Music continues during this hold after the welcome fades out.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.chase.repeat.label: Repeat background chase
shots.*.welcomeIntro.chase.repeat.description: Off plays one crossing, then leaves the background quiet until the intro is replayed.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.pageSeconds.label: Seconds per dialogue page
shots.*.welcomeIntro.pageSeconds.description: One duration per page, including the greeting first. Click or accept skips ahead and restarts the next page timer.

shots.*.welcomeIntro.musicStartDelaySeco.label: Music delay after welcome is visible

shots.*.welcomeIntro.greeting.label: Welcome dialogue
shots.*.welcomeIntro.greeting.description: Use {name} for the confirmed signature. Uses the existing overworld text box.

shots.*.flyerPrompt.backgroundBlur.label: Street blur behind flyer
shots.*.flyerPrompt.backgroundBlur.description: Zero leaves the street sharp. Units use game-resolution pixels.

shots.*.flyerPrompt.signaturePosition.label: Signature position on flyer
shots.*.flyerPrompt.signaturePosition.description: Image-relative coordinates from the top-left, from zero to one.

shots.*.flyerPrompt.tearCoastSeconds.label: Release glide duration
shots.*.flyerPrompt.tearCoastSeconds.description: Zero restores the original eased motion.

shots.*.streetFromShot.label: Reuse street scene from key
shots.*.streetFromShot.description: Shares the source street set. Local sprite actors replace the source actors when present. Camera settings stay separate.

shots.*.hiddenStreetMaterials.label: Hidden street materials for this shot

shots.*.streetModelOverride.label: Street model for this angle
shots.*.streetModelOverride.description: Replaces only the model while retaining the inherited street settings.

shots.*.nextShotKey.label: Continue to camera key
shots.*.nextShotKey.description: Cut after the shot duration in manual preview. Zero holds. P keeps its existing sequence.

shots.*.cameraFollow.stopSeconds.label: Stop following at
shots.*.cameraFollow.stopSeconds.description: Holds the camera at this time while the character keeps moving. Set -1 to follow indefinitely.

shots.*.cameraFollow.axes.label: Follow axis weights
shots.*.cameraFollow.axes.description: One follows that axis, zero keeps it fixed. Default follows the ground plane only.

shots.*.street.sign.saturation.label: Notice sign saturation
shots.*.street.sign.saturation.description: Minus one uses street saturation. Higher values retain more sign color.

shots.*.spriteActors.*.movementSteps.*.w.label: Use walk sheet instead of run

shots.*.freezeBoatWater.label: Freeze local wake and side waves

actors.*.shotKeys.label: Visible in shots
actors.*.shotKeys.description: Number array, for example [4]. Empty [] shows this actor in every shot.

shots.*.durationSeconds.label: Playback duration (seconds)
shots.*.durationSeconds.description: P plays shots in numbered order, then holds the last shot. Press P again to stop.

shots.*.foregroundBlurStrength.label: Wingull foreground blur
shots.*.foregroundBlurStrength.description: Blurs Wingull silhouettes in this shot. 0 disables the pass; 100 is an extreme blur. Boat and ocean stay sharp.

*.centerMaterialSubstrings.label: Hull materials used to find the center

vessels.*.position.label: Boat position from center
vessels.*.position.description: Zero on all axes puts the hull center at the shared scene center. Change Y to raise or lower the boat.

vessels.*.materialMotionSpeed.label: Imported UV clip speed
vessels.*.materialMotionSpeed.description: Controls imported tracks only. Materials with continuous flow overrides ignore this multiplier.

vessels.*.materialUvScroll.*.label: Continuous foam and wake flow
vessels.*.materialUvScroll.*.description: Overrides imported UV clips without loop resets. Negative U reverses flow. These speeds do not use the imported clip multiplier.

vessels.*.characterSprite.animate.label: Animate character sprite
vessels.*.characterSprite.animate.description: Disable to hold the first north-facing frame. Water and side waves keep moving.

environments.*.ocean.widthMultiplier.label: Ocean width coverage
environments.*.ocean.widthMultiplier.description: Extends water and texture repeats together. Wave size stays unchanged.

environments.*.ocean.baseOpacity.label: Base ocean opacity
environments.*.ocean.baseOpacity.description: 1 is fully textured water; 0 is the flat water color. Wake, foam, and moving streaks are unchanged.

environments.*.ocean.treadmill.enabled.label: Ocean treadmill flow
environments.*.ocean.treadmill.enabled.description: Moves base water with the streaks while keeping the boat stationary. Disable to restore the normal ocean motion.

environments.*.ocean.treadmill.speedMult.label: Treadmill speed
environments.*.ocean.treadmill.speedMult.description: 1 matches the streak speed. 0 stops base water. Negative values reverse it. Streaks and wake keep their original speed.

environments.*.ocean.treadmill.materialU.label: Treadmill base UV flow
environments.*.ocean.treadmill.materialU.description: Base-water overrides only. The mirrored sea layer needs the opposite U sign.

environments.*.ocean.materialUvScroll.*.label: Continuous ocean and veil flow
environments.*.ocean.materialUvScroll.*.description: Overrides imported UV clips without loop resets. Negative U flows away from the stern on the veil. Base ocean layers use both U and V.

environments.*.sky.position.label: Sky position
environments.*.sky.position.description: Change Y to raise or lower the dome independently of the ocean.

environments.*.sky.modelId.label: Sky model
environments.*.sky.modelId.description: Choose the original ocean-set sky or the separate daytime dome. This does not change the ocean.

actors.*.position.label: Flight position from center
actors.*.position.description: Uses the same center as the boat. Y is the flight height above that point. Zero XYZ overlaps a boat at zero XYZ.

actors.*.velocity.label: Flight speed by direction
actors.*.velocity.description: Negative Z flies toward the bow of option C. Zero on all axes holds position.

actors.*.foregroundBlurRadius.label: Legacy texture softness
actors.*.foregroundBlurRadius.description: Keep at 0 for sharp textures. Use the shot Wingull foreground blur control for out-of-focus silhouettes.

actors.*.foregroundBlurStrength.label: Individual foreground blur
actors.*.foregroundBlurStrength.description: -1 inherits the shot blur. 0 is sharp. A positive value overrides this bird only. Disabling blur on the shot keeps all birds sharp.
